title: Uber puts all 30,000 employees on ChatGPT Work
hook_text: Uber just onboarded 30,000 employees to ChatGPT
script:
Thirty thousand Uber employees just gained full access to ChatGPT Work.
Uber is moving from a limited pilot to an enterprise-wide rollout.
This move follows a smaller pilot program launched earlier this year.
The company is betting big on AI to boost productivity across its global workforce.
Executives expect this deployment to shift how teams handle day-to-day operations.
The decision underscores the rapid adoption of enterprise AI tools in major corporations.
Would you want your company to provide AI access to all staff?

editor.one_line: Strong news, but lines 4-6 are vague corporate filler that dilute the impact.
script_fixes: LINE 4: Replace 'betting big on AI' with 'aiming to automate routine administrative tasks'.
LINE 5: Replace 'shift how teams handle day-to-day operations' with 'reduce time spent on email drafting and meeting summaries'.
LINE 6: Replace 'underscores the rapid adoption' with 'marks a shift toward enterprise-wide AI integration'.
visual_notes: line 3: The 'Uber logo' text label is redundant and unprofessional.
line 4: The visual is a static text card; it needs a relevant graphic or data visualization.
line 6: The visual is a repeat of the previous style; lacks visual variety.
